title: Enterprise estate (four platforms, one diagram)
description: Four large platforms drawn together to see how the tool behaves at well over a hundred components: retail, a bank's payments core, the data and ML platform, and a connected fleet. Cross-platform links show shared identity, data and events.

detail.role: People browsing and buying on the website.
detail.why: The largest source of traffic and revenue.

detail.role: People using the native apps.
detail.why: Highest conversion; the app also carries loyalty and push.

detail.role: Tills, kiosks and handhelds in physical stores.
detail.why: Stores sell and fulfil from the same stock as online.

risks.text: Store networks drop. Tills queue sales locally and sync when the link returns.

detail.role: Sends each shopper to the nearest healthy region.
detail.why: A regional failure becomes a routing change, not an outage.

detail.role: Serves images, scripts and cached pages from a point near the shopper.
detail.why: Most page weight never reaches the platform, which keeps peak sales affordable.

cost.text: A cache hit costs a fraction of an origin request. A peak sale is mostly CDN traffic.

detail.role: Blocks injection attempts, scrapers and credential-stuffing bots before they reach any service.
detail.why: Abuse is stopped at the edge, so it never competes with real shoppers for capacity.

security.text: Rate limits, bot scoring and managed rules apply to every request.

detail.role: The single front door: routes, throttles and authenticates calls.
detail.why: Teams change internals freely while the public contract stays stable.

security.text: Every public call is authenticated and throttled here before reaching a service.

detail.role: Combines several services into the exact shapes the website needs.
detail.why: The site makes one call, not twelve.

detail.role: Does the same for the apps, with smaller payloads and offline-friendly responses.
detail.why: Phones get what they need on poor networks.

detail.role: Serves tills and kiosks, with local fallbacks.
detail.why: A store can keep selling when the head office is slow.

detail.role: Accounts, social sign-in, multi-factor and consent records.
detail.why: One login across web, app and store; consent is stored once.

security.text: Marketing and data consent are captured per account and checked before any use.

detail.role: Turns features on for a share of shoppers and off instantly.
detail.why: A bad release is switched off in seconds, with no redeploy.

detail.role: Owns product data, pricing and promotions.
detail.why: One truth for what is sold and for how much.

detail.role: Tracks stock in warehouses and stores and reserves it for orders.
detail.why: Shoppers are never sold what is not there.
detail.tradeoff: Reservations must expire, or abandoned baskets lock stock.

detail.role: Holds the cart, applies offers and prices the order.
detail.why: Checkout stays fast because it holds only what it needs.

detail.role: Creates and tracks orders from payment to delivery.
detail.why: A single record of what happened to every order.

detail.role: Talks to the payment provider, handles retries and refunds.
detail.why: Card data never touches the rest of the platform.

security.text: Only tokens are stored. The card number goes straight to the provider.

risks.text: If the provider is down, checkout fails. A second provider is configured for failover.

detail.role: Plans picking and shipping and books carriers.
detail.why: Orders leave the cheapest, closest location.

detail.role: Earns and spends points and issues personal offers.
detail.why: Repeat purchases are rewarded the same way on every channel.

detail.role: Answers search and browse queries.
detail.why: Finding the product is the first step of every sale.

detail.role: Suggests products per shopper from behaviour and similar baskets.
detail.why: Raises basket size with no manual merchandising.

cost.text: Models run on a small GPU pool. Cost follows traffic.

detail.role: Suggests price changes from demand, stock and competitor prices.
detail.why: Margin improves on slow lines and stock sells through.

risks.text: Price changes are capped and reviewed. Unbounded pricing models damage trust.

detail.role: Scores every order for fraud risk before payment is captured.
detail.why: Loss is stopped before money moves.

security.text: Every score and decision is stored with its inputs for dispute handling.

detail.role: Sends order, delivery and offer messages.
detail.why: Shoppers hear about their order without asking.

detail.role: Applies per-team quotas, limits and routing rules.
detail.why: Teams cannot starve each other.

detail.role: Carries every business event: order placed, stock changed, payment captured.
detail.why: Services stay independent and new consumers need no change to producers.

security.text: Each service can publish and read only its own topics.

detail.role: Product and price documents.
detail.why: Reads scale with the CDN-fronted catalogue.

detail.role: Stock levels with strong consistency.
detail.why: Reservations must never oversell.

detail.role: Orders, lines and state changes.
detail.why: Money and legal records need transactions.

security.text: Encrypted at rest with point-in-time recovery.

detail.role: Holds sessions and baskets for fast reads.
detail.why: Checkout latency stays low at peak.

detail.role: The searchable copy of the catalogue.
detail.why: Keyword and facet queries return in milliseconds.

detail.role: Raw and curated data from every system.
detail.why: One place for analytics and model training.

cost.text: Old data moves to cheaper tiers automatically.

detail.role: Modelled data for reporting.
detail.why: Finance and merchandising use one set of numbers.

detail.role: Per-shopper and per-product features, online and offline.
detail.why: Training and serving use identical inputs.

detail.role: Authorises and captures payments.
detail.why: Specialists carry the card-network certification.

detail.role: Book shipments and return tracking events.
detail.why: Delivery options come from several carriers.

detail.role: Third-party sellers list and fulfil through the platform.
detail.why: A bigger range without holding the stock.

detail.role: Calculates tax per country and state.
detail.why: Rules change often and are someone else's job.

detail.role: Code and configuration for every service.
detail.why: Every change is reviewed and traceable.

detail.role: Builds, tests and scans each change.
detail.why: Nothing reaches production unchecked.

security.text: Dependencies and images are scanned and signed in the pipeline.

detail.role: Stores signed container images.
detail.why: Clusters run only what the pipeline built.

detail.role: Applies the desired state from Git to each cluster.
detail.why: Production matches the repository, and a rollback is a revert.

detail.role: Creates networks, clusters and databases.
detail.why: Environments are repeatable.

detail.role: Stores secrets and encryption keys.
detail.why: No secret lives in code or images.

security.text: Secrets rotate automatically and are issued per workload.

detail.role: Encrypts and authenticates calls between services.
detail.why: A compromised service cannot freely call the rest.

security.text: Every call is mutually authenticated and checked against policy.

detail.role: Collects metrics, logs and traces from every service.
detail.why: Slow checkouts are found before shoppers complain.

detail.role: Correlates security events and raises alerts.
detail.why: Attacks are noticed in minutes.

detail.role: Pages the owning team when a service level slips.
detail.why: Someone who can fix it is told at once.

detail.role: Everyday banking for personal customers.
detail.why: The main way customers see their money.

detail.role: Where company clients initiate bulk payments and see cash positions.
detail.why: Large flows come through here, with dual approval.

detail.role: Tools for staff to serve customers.
detail.why: Staff see the same data as the customer, with their own permissions.

security.text: Staff see only what their role allows, and every access is logged.

detail.role: Registered fintechs that access accounts with customer consent.
detail.why: Regulation requires the bank to offer it.

security.text: Every call carries a consent token the customer can withdraw.

detail.role: Card authorisations and cash withdrawals.
detail.why: Cards are still a large share of volume.

detail.role: Other banks sending and receiving payments.
detail.why: Payments leave and enter the bank this way.

detail.role: Authenticates, throttles and routes every API call.
detail.why: One enforcement point for security and quotas.

security.text: Calls need multi-factor authentication and a valid consent for sensitive actions.

detail.role: Sign-in, multi-factor and fine-grained roles.
detail.why: One identity for every channel.

security.text: Roles are granted by request and expire; admin access is time-boxed.

detail.role: Stores and enforces customer consent for data sharing.
detail.why: Customers control who sees their data.

detail.role: Carries events between systems and adapts old interfaces.
detail.why: Core systems are not changed for every new channel.

detail.role: Runs multi-step flows such as onboarding and loan approval.
detail.why: Long-running work survives restarts and has a full audit.

detail.role: Stores statements and customer documents.
detail.why: Retention rules are applied in one place.

security.text: Records are write-once and retained for the legal period.

detail.role: Receives every payment, validates it, picks the scheme and tracks it to completion.
detail.why: One flow for all payment types instead of one system per scheme.
detail.tradeoff: It is on the critical path of every payment, so it is the most heavily tested component.

detail.role: Converts between channel formats and the standard message format.
detail.why: New schemes cost one adapter, not a rewrite.

detail.role: Scores each payment against behaviour and known patterns.
detail.why: Fraud is stopped before the money leaves.

risks.text: Fraud patterns change. Models are retrained and monitored for drift.

detail.role: Checks parties against sanctions lists and flags unusual activity.
detail.why: The bank must not process prohibited payments.

security.text: A possible match holds the payment for a human decision.

detail.role: Applies daily limits and watches the bank's cash at each scheme.
detail.why: Stops a runaway process and avoids a failed settlement.

detail.role: Connects to the instant payment scheme with strict response times.
detail.why: The scheme gives seconds to respond.

risks.text: Timeouts are reported to the scheme as failures. Capacity is sized for peak with headroom.

detail.role: Files for bulk and direct-debit schemes.
detail.why: Payroll and direct debits run in windows.

detail.role: Sends and receives cross-border messages.
detail.why: International payments use a different network.

detail.role: Authorises card transactions in milliseconds.
detail.why: Card spend is checked against balance and limits in real time.

detail.role: Holds the keys that sign and encrypt payments and PINs.
detail.why: Keys never leave tamper-resistant hardware.

security.text: Keys are generated and used inside hardware modules, with dual control.

detail.role: The system of record for every account and posting.
detail.why: A single, consistent set of balances.

risks.text: Changes are slow and risky. New features live in the layer around it.

detail.role: A synchronous copy for recovery.
detail.why: A lost data centre loses no posted transaction.

detail.role: Defines products, interest and fees.
detail.why: Pricing is configured, not coded.

detail.role: One record per customer across products.
detail.why: Everyone works from the same customer.

security.text: Sensitive fields are masked unless the role needs them.

detail.role: All transactions and reference data for analysis.
detail.why: Reporting and models use one governed copy.

cost.text: Compute is billed only while queries and jobs run.

detail.role: Streams ledger changes to the lakehouse within seconds.
detail.why: Reports and fraud models see today's data.

detail.role: Customer and account features for models.
detail.why: Training and serving use the same inputs.

detail.role: Calculates exposures, capital and stress scenarios.
detail.why: The bank knows its risk position daily.

detail.role: Records what each dataset is, who owns it and where it came from.
detail.why: Regulators ask where a number came from; this answers it.

detail.role: Produces the reports regulators require.
detail.why: Reports come from governed data, with lineage.

detail.role: Collects security events and raises alerts.
detail.why: Attacks are detected and investigated around the clock.

detail.role: Issues short-lived admin access with session recording.
detail.why: No standing admin rights.

security.text: Every privileged session is recorded and reviewed.

detail.role: Runs the plan that moves service to the standby site.
detail.why: Recovery is rehearsed, not improvised.

risks.text: A plan that has not been exercised recently cannot be trusted. Tests run quarterly.

detail.role: Service levels and traces across all systems.
detail.why: A slow payment is traced to the system causing it.

detail.role: Builds, tests and releases changes, with approvals for production.
detail.why: Every change is reviewed, tested and recorded.

security.text: Production changes need an independent approval.

detail.role: Separates channels, payments and core by network policy.
detail.why: A breach in one zone does not open the others.

security.text: Traffic between segments is denied unless a rule allows it.

detail.role: Orders, invoices, stock.
detail.why: The financial record of the business.

detail.role: Customers, leads and cases.
detail.why: The commercial view of each customer.

detail.role: Databases behind the company's own applications.
detail.why: Where most business events first land.

risks.text: Heavy extracts slow the application. Change capture reads the log instead.

detail.role: Cloud tools that hold business data.
detail.why: Data outside the walls still has to be analysed.

detail.role: Machines and devices that send readings.
detail.why: High-volume time series.

detail.role: Data from suppliers and customers.
detail.why: Often the only source for external facts.

risks.text: Files arrive late, malformed or changed. Every feed is validated on entry.

detail.role: Clickstream and service logs.
detail.why: Behavioural data.

detail.role: Reads the logs of operational databases and emits changes.
detail.why: Fresh data with almost no load on the source.

detail.role: Pulls files and API data on a schedule.
detail.why: Simple and cheap for data that changes slowly.

detail.role: Carries streams of events with replay.
detail.why: Producers and consumers are decoupled, and history can be replayed.

detail.role: Cleans, joins and aggregates streams.
detail.why: Results in seconds, not at the next batch.

detail.role: Runs and monitors every batch pipeline and its dependencies.
detail.why: A late file delays only what depends on it.

detail.role: Stores and enforces data schemas.
detail.why: A producer cannot break its consumers.

security.text: A breaking change is refused when it is published.

detail.role: Data exactly as received, kept immutable.
detail.why: Anything can be reprocessed from the original.

security.text: Encrypted with keys per domain; objects cannot be changed.

cost.text: Cold data moves to low-cost storage automatically.

detail.role: Deduplicated, typed and validated data.
detail.why: A reliable base for everyone.

detail.role: Aggregates and marts shaped for use.
detail.why: Everyone uses the same definition of revenue.

detail.role: Runs the transformations between stages.
detail.why: Scales to the largest jobs and releases the machines after.

cost.text: Most nodes are spot instances; jobs retry if one is reclaimed.

detail.role: Serves analysts and dashboards.
detail.why: Fast answers on the gold layer.

cost.text: Idle warehouses suspend, so dashboards cost nothing overnight.

detail.role: Tests every table for freshness, nulls and ranges.
detail.why: Bad data is caught before it reaches a report.

detail.role: Stores embeddings for search and retrieval.
detail.why: Powers semantic search and assistants over company data.

detail.role: Where data scientists explore and build.
detail.why: Fast iteration against real data.

security.text: Notebooks read governed tables and cannot copy data out.

detail.role: Reusable model inputs, served the same way in training and production.
detail.why: No mismatch between training and serving.

detail.role: Trains and tunes models.
detail.why: Experiments are repeatable.

cost.text: GPU hours dominate cost; jobs are queued and scheduled, with quotas per team.

detail.role: Stores each model version with its data, code and metrics.
detail.why: Every production model is traceable.

security.text: Only approved versions can be deployed.

detail.role: Serves predictions with autoscaling.
detail.why: Applications call a model like any other service.

detail.role: Routes requests to hosted language models with quotas and filtering.
detail.why: One governed way to use generative models.

security.text: Sensitive data is masked and outputs are filtered before they leave the gateway.

detail.role: Watches inputs and outputs for drift and bias.
detail.why: A model that is wrong is noticed and retrained.

detail.role: Reports and dashboards for the business.
detail.why: Decisions use governed numbers.

detail.role: Applications that read data and predictions through APIs.
detail.why: Data becomes a feature of the product.

detail.role: People who explore data directly.
detail.why: Answers without a request to IT.

detail.role: Shares selected data with partners.
detail.why: Sharing without copying files around.

security.text: Partners see only agreed rows and columns, and every query is logged.

detail.role: Sends scores and segments back to operational tools.
detail.why: Insight reaches the people who act.

detail.role: Describes every dataset, owner and flow.
detail.why: People find and trust data.

detail.role: Defines who can see which data.
detail.why: One policy, enforced in every engine.

security.text: Access follows tags on data and attributes of people, not hand-made grants.

detail.role: Holds encryption keys and secrets.
detail.why: Keys are separate from the data they protect.

detail.role: Tracks where each column came from and where it goes.
detail.why: An error is traced to its source; a change shows who is affected.

detail.role: Allocates cost to teams and alerts on overruns.
detail.why: A job cannot silently spend a month's budget.

detail.role: Metrics and alerts for pipelines and jobs.
detail.why: Late or failed data is noticed first by the platform.

detail.role: Tests and deploys pipelines, models and infrastructure.
detail.why: Changes are reviewed and repeatable.

detail.role: Finds and tags personal data.
detail.why: Protection follows the tag.

security.text: New columns are scanned and tagged on arrival.

detail.role: Connected vehicles that report position, health and usage.
detail.why: The fleet is the product.

risks.text: Vehicles lose coverage. Units buffer readings and send them when the link returns.

detail.role: Machines in customer sites.
detail.why: Condition data predicts failures.

detail.role: Charging points and depot systems.
detail.why: Energy use is a large operating cost.

detail.role: Apps used by drivers and field staff.
detail.why: People act on what the platform shows.

detail.role: Collects readings from local devices, filters and forwards them.
detail.why: Cuts traffic and keeps working offline.

detail.role: Runs small models near the device.
detail.why: Decisions that cannot wait for the cloud.

detail.role: Stores readings while the link is down.
detail.why: No data is lost in an outage.

detail.role: Sends each device to its nearest region.
detail.why: Low latency and regional failover.

detail.role: Accepts device connections and messages.
detail.why: Millions of connections at low cost.

security.text: Each device connects with its own certificate. A revoked device cannot reconnect.

detail.role: Issues and revokes device certificates.
detail.why: Every device has its own identity.

security.text: A stolen device is revoked individually, without affecting others.

detail.role: Routes messages by topic to streams and stores.
detail.why: New use needs a rule, not code.

detail.role: Rejects malformed messages and decodes binary payloads.
detail.why: Bad data stops here.

detail.role: Holds messages that could not be processed.
detail.why: Nothing is dropped silently.

detail.role: Sends commands to devices and tracks acknowledgement.
detail.why: Remote actions are queued, authorised and recorded.

security.text: Every command needs a role and is written to the audit log.

detail.role: Carries telemetry for all consumers.
detail.why: Many consumers read the same data independently.

cost.text: Seven days of retention; older data lives in the lake.

detail.role: Aggregates readings, joins with reference data and detects events.
detail.why: Alerts in seconds.

detail.role: Recent readings indexed by device and time.
detail.why: Fast dashboards and diagnostics.

detail.role: All raw and curated telemetry.
detail.why: Model training and long-term analysis.

cost.text: Data older than 90 days moves to archive storage.

detail.role: The latest known state of every vehicle and machine.
detail.why: Applications ask for the current state, not for a stream.

detail.role: Answers questions like 'which vehicles are near this depot'.
detail.why: Dispatch and geofencing.

detail.role: Per-asset features for models.
detail.why: Training and serving use identical inputs.

detail.role: Trains failure-prediction and energy models.
detail.why: Fixing a part before it fails is cheaper than a breakdown.

detail.role: Scores assets as new data arrives.
detail.why: Risk scores update continuously.

detail.role: Live fleet map, alerts and diagnostics.
detail.why: Operators see problems and act.

detail.role: Turns detected events into notifications and tickets.
detail.why: The right team hears about it.

detail.role: Exposes fleet data to customers and partners.
detail.why: Data becomes a product.

security.text: A customer can only see its own assets.

detail.role: Reports on utilisation, cost and reliability.
detail.why: Management decisions.

detail.role: Turns usage into invoices.
detail.why: Customers pay for what they use.

detail.role: Work orders, parts and contracts.
detail.why: A predicted failure becomes a work order automatically.

detail.role: Plans and delivers firmware and software updates.
detail.why: Fixing thousands of devices without visiting them.

risks.text: A bad update could disable devices. Rollouts are staged, and a device reverts if it fails its health check.

detail.role: Signs every update.
detail.why: Devices install only what the company signed.

security.text: Devices verify the signature and refuse anything else.

detail.role: Holds the desired settings per group of devices.
detail.why: Change a group, not a device.

detail.role: Controls who can see and command which assets.
detail.why: Least privilege for operators.

detail.role: Records every command, update and access.
detail.why: Disputes and incidents can be reconstructed.

detail.role: Service levels for the platform itself.
detail.why: The platform's own health.

detail.role: Builds, tests and ships platform and firmware.
detail.why: Repeatable releases.

detail.role: Looks for compromised devices and abuse.
detail.why: A hijacked device is found from its behaviour.

layers.label: Retail: Edge and channels
layers.summary: Where shoppers and stores arrive: devices, the CDN, DNS and the web firewall.

layers.label: Retail: Experience
layers.summary: One backend for each channel: it shapes the platform's data for web, mobile and stores, and handles sign-in.

layers.label: Retail: Domain services
layers.summary: The business capabilities, each owned by one team and deployed on Kubernetes.

layers.label: Retail: Data and events
layers.summary: Where state lives and how facts move: databases, caches, search, the event backbone and the data lake.

layers.label: Retail: Partners
layers.summary: Outside parties the platform calls or is called by.

layers.label: Retail: Delivery, security and operations
layers.summary: How changes ship and how the platform is secured and watched.

layers.label: Bank: Channels
layers.summary: Who the bank serves and how they arrive.

layers.label: Bank: API and integration
layers.summary: The controlled front door and the integration layer between channels and core systems.

layers.label: Bank: Payments and risk

layers.label: Bank: Core and data
